text:
Elaine: Quick idea  regroup left rail into workflows (Data / Models / Deploy). Keeps deep links predictable.
Sam: Uploaded tiny Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/example/rail-compactness
Priya: Concern about cramped rail on narrow screens - avoid double scroll.
Matt: Auto-collapse groups <=1200px; keyboard arrow nav inside groups, Enter/Space toggles.
DesignBot: A11y notes: aria-expanded, aria-controls, move focus to first link on expand, return focus on collapse, expose Skip to main on keyboard. Announce client-side rewrites to SR.
Elaine: Plan to rewrite legacy fragments (#predictions) to path segments (/predictions) using history.replaceState and preserve query params. Show one-time toast.
Sam: Preserve ?from_dashboard and log old->new mapping. Add puppeteer tests for focus order and skip link.
Priya: Keep ephemeral overlays as query params (?overlay=compose).
Matt: Breadcrumbs use slugs not IDs; collapse middle crumbs on mobile with overflow menu.
Elaine: Decision: grouped rail + canonical fragment->path rewrites + responsive accordion + a11y focus rules + preserve query params. I'll write spec and RFC.
thread_summary: Short design thread: regroup sidebar by workflow, rewrite anchors to paths client-side, responsive accordion, a11y rules, preserve query params, canary rollout planning.
